learning_outcomes.text: Acquire practical skills for designing material handling equipment.
Develop the construction of basic mechanisms of widely used materials handling equipment.
Acquire design skills using prospectus materials, technical manuals, reference books and standards.

syllabus_topics: General instructions for development of the course project.
The place of the machine in a technological process.
Basics of the rational construction of Material Handling Engineering, loading and ways of calculation, materials for manufacturing Materials Handling Equipment.
Drawing of cinematic schemes of a machine in several versions, analysis and choice of a version.
Project calculation of machine mechanisms for selecting appropriate aggregates.
Dynamic tests, selection of an engine, rough calculation and checking the elements of mechanisms.
teaching_methods: tutorials in a special room for course projects
use of prospectus materials, technical manuals, reference books and standards
assessment_rules: The final mark is formed after a public defense of the project.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
